FLASHSCORE PREVIEW

Mauricio Pochettino goes into his first home game in charge of Manchester United still searching for his first win, and a formidable Brentford side should offer stern opposition here.

Match News and Current Form

It’s now just one win in 13 matches in all competitions for Manchester United (D5, L7), who were left aggrieved at drawing 2-2 with Sporting CP in a midweek UEFA Champions League fixture marred by controversial refereeing decisions. The Red Devils also fell victim to one in their last Premier League game, receiving an early red card that’s since been overturned in a heavy 4-0 defeat to arch-rivals Liverpool which stretched their Premier League winless run to nine games (D5, L4), a negative club record in the competition. United will play a third successive league match having started the day in the relegation zone for the first time since 1986, with Pochettino also at risk of becoming just their third manager to oversee defeat in his opening two league fixtures.

Erik ten Hag was the last United manager to suffer that fate and the second defeat therein came against Brentford, who travel north full of confidence after thrashing Everton 4-0 on Monday. The Bees have posted their best points tally (17) after 11 games of a Premier League season, and start the round occupying a top-six position as a result. There’s still plenty of room for improvement for Keith Andrews’ side though, as they’ve failed to win any of their last ten away league matches (D7, L3), their longest such run since 2018!

Head-to-Head History

Brentford may have won two of the last three H2Hs (L1), but have lost all five of their Premier League visits to Old Trafford. United have only faced three sides more in the competition at home while winning each time.

Win Probability
Opta by StatsPerform
Hot Stats and Streaks

United have conceded 2+ goals in each of their last five halves of Premier League football - no team has ever done so in six.

Twelve of United’s last 14 home games have produced over 2.5 goals.

Brentford have scored first in a pre-round league-high nine matches this season.

Just two of Brentford’s 11 league games this term stood goalless at half-time.

Key Players to Watch and Missing Players

United captain Bruno Fernandes netted a brace in midweek and sits just one short of 150 Premier League goal involvements (G75, A74) - only seven players have scored and assisted 75 in the competition. Jaidon Anthony has scored in his last two games against United and has four assists in his last five Premier League matches, one more than he managed in his first 75 such appearances.

Carlos Baleba and Benjamin Šeško remain sidelined for United while Marcus Rashford remains doubtful. Brentford are without Aaron Hickey and Nathan Collins.

For all the latest team news, please check the Flashscore match centre.

Betting Analysis

United are a chaos magnet at present, which makes over 3.5 goals an option worth looking at here.

Author: Ryan Fisher
